allow: PowerShell($nvm = Get-ChildItem "$env:APPDATA\\nvm" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; $nvm; Get-ChildItem "C:\\nvm" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 3)

PowerShell($drives = @\('C:', 'D:'\); foreach \($d in $drives\) { Get-ChildItem "$d\\" -Filter "node.exe" -Recurse -Depth 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName | Select-Object -First 3 })
